description:
[I will turn your dreams into reality.]

A small ray of hope left ten years ago by his late mother: an inheritance of a special membership to the Erebos Hotel. Driven by a desire to paint the monsters that appear in his own dreams, Jess enters the hotel with a heart full of expectation.

[You must draw the window curtains after sunset. Please do not look out the window or step outside the hotel.]

Bizarre rules, incomprehensible events—and guests who begin to vanish, one by one, through death or sudden disappearance.

*“That’s right, Jess. I want you.”*

Amidst the growing danger, Jess finds himself helplessly falling for one man, but...

*“So I’ll make sure you won't ever be able to regret it.”*

The reason he grows more terrified by the day is because the man is hiding so much. Though everyone warns him to be careful, there is only one thing Jess truly wants to know.

*“Caiman.”*

My one and only gentle savior. Do you truly love me? *(Source: RIDI novel page, translated)*

**Original Novel:**  
Volumes: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/809046717), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/donga98236), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000112486), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=10714538), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=923032810)
